remarks: Gorgeous light and bright contemporary on Webbs Hill Road. One level acre with lovely plantings and pool. Huge master suite and two other bedrooms one of which has steps up to sitting room or office or baby/nanny suite. House in excellent condition with pristine wood floors, tiled foyer, updated kitchen and bathrooms. Large family room with bathroom could be guest quarters. Hardwood floors throughout. Finished spacious lower level with fitness equipment. Two large garages can accommodate 4 cars. Brand new energy efficient oil burner and two new cooling systems. New front door and new windows. Owner has small storage area in lower level. Brokers please make sure all doors including garages closed and all lights turned off. Must have excellent credit. Must have confirmed appointment - please use showing time. Premises have been thoroughly cleaned and updated where necessary. Please note living and dining rooms have been repainted with neutral colors.
